title: Jazzy Venezuelan Fish Wrap
description: A spicy, citrusy fish wrap with a glassy glaze, wrapped in steamed collard greens for a post-workout, anti-inflammatory boost.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and add olive oil.
Season the tilapia fillet with cumin, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and just cooked through, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add lime juice, orange juice, and coconut sugar, stirring until syrupy.
Return the fish to the skillet and coat it in the citrus glaze for 30 seconds.
Steam the collard greens leaves in a steamer basket or covered pan for 3 minutes until pliable.
Spread the glazed fish onto each collard leaf, then top with minced habanero, grated ginger, and turmeric.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the fish and gently roll the leaf into a wrap.
Serve the wraps immediately, optionally drizzling a bit of the remaining glaze on top.
Enjoy the vibrant, anti-inflammatory Venezuelan fish wrap as a post-workout lunch.
